September 7, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Globe publishes in its Readers' Forum the following letter
written by one Chen Ts-shi (陳自童):

THE KAN SZE MIDDLE SCHOOL

To the Editor:
Since the Tseng Sze Middle School (正始中学)
closed its doors, Chen Chun (陳群), the principal, in
order to please his "master," established a school
known as the Kan Sze Middle School (更始中学) in the
vicinity of the Tseng Sze Middle School. Under the
cloak of free education, the newly established school is
attempting to induce innocent youths to accept the
education of a slave, thereby training them to be traitors.
It is reported that many innocent youths have joined the
school.
The war of resistance is still going on and
for this reason, we should not remain indifferent and let
innocent youths fall into the trap; it will be harmful to
the country. In the interests of education in Shanghai,
we must not permit this organ of shameless Chinese
traitors to exist in a Foreign Settlement that adopts
neutrality.
I suggest that the following two measures be
adopted to deal with the situation:-
1) That those youths who have fallen into the trap be
rescued by means of various forms of publicity; that
they be urged to come to their senses and leave
the school; that the parents of these youths be persuaded
not to overlook the future of their children.
2) That the authorities of the Foreign Settlement concerned
be requested to drive the school away from the Settlement
for the sake of peace and good order in the district.
Although Shanghai is now an "isolated island"
the patriotism of the people is by no means less fervid
than that of people in the interior. It is hoped that
the Chinese in Shanghai will not overlook this matter but
rise to overthrow this traitorous Kan Sze Middle School.

〔批注：〕
Commw
Sec
This school is
in French Concession.
French Police have copy
of this Translation
J.W. Robertson
DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
(SPECIAL BRANCH)

Thank.

1938年12月29日

1938年9月7日下午译本。

《环球报》（Globe）在其“读者论坛”栏目刊登了以下由陈自童（Chen Ts-shi）撰写的信件：

更始中学

致编辑：
自从正始中学（Tseng Sze Middle School）关闭以来，校长陈群（Chen Chun）为了取悦其“主子”，在正始中学附近建立了一所名为更始中学（Kan Sze Middle School）的学校。这所新成立的学校打着免费教育的幌子，试图诱使无辜青年接受奴化教育，从而将他们培养成汉奸。据悉，许多无辜青年已加入该校。
抗战仍在继续，因此我们不应漠不关心，任由无辜青年落入陷阱；这将危害国家。为了上海的教育利益，我们决不允许这个无耻汉奸的机构存在于采取中立立场的外国租界内。
我建议采取以下两项措施来应对这一局面：
1) 通过各种形式的宣传，营救那些落入陷阱的青年；敦促他们醒悟并离开学校；劝说这些青年的父母不要忽视子女的前途。
2) 请求有关外国租界当局为了该地区的和平与良好秩序，将该学校驱逐出租界。
虽然上海现在是一座“孤岛”，但人民的爱国热情绝不亚于内地人民。希望上海的中国人不要忽视此事，奋起推翻这个叛国的更始中学。

〔批注：〕
Commw
Sec
该校位于
法租界。
法国警察持有
本译文副本
J.W. Robertson
副总监
（特别股）

谢谢。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. H.C.
B. D. 7652
Special Branch. 2 xxxxx / 2
Date December 16, 1936.

Subject Attached report re arrest of two passengers on the s.s. Empress of Japan.

Made by ________________ and ________________ Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

Enquiries confirm the report that two politicians from Kwangsi bearing the names of Huang Zien Ping (黃建平) and Chen Siao Sien (程曉仙) were arrested on December 13 on board the s.s. Empress of Japan by detectives from the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner's Office and from the Public Safety Bureau.

Discreet enquiries show that the order of arrest was based on a telegram from the Military Council of Nanking sent separately to Mayor Wu and General Yang Hu charging the prisoners with being agents of Kwangsi militarists plotting against the Nanking Government. Hence the joint action taken.

In the luggage seized on the steamer were found a number of telegraph code books and a quantity of books entitled "San Min Chu I (Three Principles) Monthly Magazine" (三民主義) published in Canton the contents of which are highly inflammable and anti-Government in nature.

The magazines seized are exactly similar to the magazines transported in two cases from Tientsin to Thomas Cook & Sons, Shanghai, on November 28 for delivery to Mr. Teng Chu Yu (鄧祖禹) of Shanghai, and which formed the subject of a report by D.S. Pitts on December 3.

Mr. Chen Siao Sien, one of the prisoners, is a native of Kiangsi. In 1927 he served as Judge to the Military Court of General Yang Hu, who was also Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner at that time. It would appear, therefore, that Chen Siao Sien and Chen Chun (陳群) are intimate friends and were both in the service of General Yang Hu in 1927. The whole gang including Chen Chun, Chen Siao Sien, Teng Chu Yu must have worked together in carrying out anti-Chiang propaganda.

（左侧页边批注及印章）：

主题 关于逮捕“日本皇后号”轮船两名乘客的附件报告。

由 ___ 和 ___ 制作。由谭绍良（Tan Shao-liang）警司转发。

查询证实了如下报告：12月13日，来自吴淞上海防卫委员公署和公安局的侦探在“日本皇后号”轮船上逮捕了两名来自广西的政治人物，名为黄建平（Huang Zien Ping）和程晓仙（Chen Siao Sien）。

谨慎的调查表明，逮捕令是基于南京军事委员会分别发给吴市长和杨虎将军的电报，指控囚犯为策划反对南京政府的广西军阀代理人。因此采取了联合行动。

在轮船上查获的行李中，发现了许多电报密码本和大量题为《三民主义月刊》（San Min Chu I Monthly Magazine）的书籍，该书在广州出版，内容极具煽动性且具反政府性质。

查获的杂志与11月28日从天津运至上海托马斯·库克父子公司（Thomas Cook & Sons）、交付给上海邓祖禹先生（Mr. Teng Chu Yu）的两箱杂志完全相同，后者构成了D.S. Pitts于12月3日报告的主题。

囚犯之一的程晓仙先生是江西人。1927年，他担任杨虎将军军事法庭的法官，杨虎当时也是吴淞上海卫戍司令。因此，程晓仙与陈群（Chen Chun）似乎是密友，两人于1927年均在杨虎将军麾下任职。包括陈群、程晓仙、邓祖禹在内的整个团伙必定共同合作，进行反蒋宣传。

代表广西政治人物，以及陈群随后向法国警察、并在从托马斯·库克父子公司接收书籍之前向杨虎将军提交的报告，是故意用来迷惑当局的，因为陈群在有机会查看箱子之前，怎么可能知道里面装有反动文献呢（参见致法国警察的信）。

另一名囚犯黄建平，广西人，是一名军官，据说是李宗仁将军在上海的个人代表。

此案的一个奇怪发展是，在囚犯于12月14日从上海转移至南京后不久，杨虎将军收到了南京军政部长何应钦将军的电报，命令杨将军释放囚犯。

综上所述，显然反蒋活动正由广西代理人在上海及北方秘密进行，鉴于西安事变，南京政府不敢过于严厉地对待其政治对手。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No..........
S.1, Special Branch XXXXX,
REPORT
Date December 15, 19 36.
Subject Arrest of two Chinese on board the s.s. "Empress of Japan"
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [签名]

It is reported that acting on instructions from
the Nanking Government, detectives from the Woosung-Shanghai
Defence Commissioner's Headquarters and the Bureau of Public
Safety, arrested on December 13 on board the s.s. "Empress
of Japan" two Chinese passengers named Huang Zien-ping
( 黄 建 平 ) and Chen Siao-sien ( 程  仙 ). These two
persons, who were sent under escort to Nanking on December 14,
are said to be members of the South-West Clique, who have
been sent here by General Li Tsung-jen ( 李 宗 仁 ), their
mission being unknown.
It is further reported that Chen Chao-sien, one of
the two prisoners, was once a departmental chief serving
under General Yang Hu, Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner.
There is no confirmation of the report that
General Li Tsung-jen was on board the same vessel.

[左侧手写批注：D.B. / 1/2]

Sih Tse hiang
D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

Date December 3, 19 36

Subject Arrival of two cases of anti-Government literature from Tientsin
addressed to Teng Chou Yu(鄧周渝).

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

With reference to the contents of the attached translation
of a letter addressed to the French Police by Chen Chun (陳春),
principal of the Cheng Shih(成始) Secondary School, 108
Route Say Zoong, I have to report that one Li Vung Ping(李文炳),
a representative of both Chen Chun and Teng Chou Yu, called on
Messrs. Thos. Cook & Sons at about 10.40 a.m. December 3, 1936
and paid the sum of $16.38 which represented transportation
and delivery fees for the two cases in question.

With the permission of and accompanied by Li Vung Ping,
D.S. Pitts and Clerk Lung Loong Oen proceeded to Messrs. Thos.
Cook & Sons' godown on Canton Road at 11 a.m. and examined
the contents of the cases.

Some 2,500 copies of the attached booklet entitled "San
Min Chu I Monthly"(三民主義月刊) were found. A closer inspect-
ion showed that these copies comprised Vol. 8, Issues Nos. 1
and 2 combined, dated August 31, 1936. Its editor is One Liu
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / - 4 DEC. 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
Tso Ying(劉左瀛), a prominent member of the South Western
Group of Mr. Hu Han Min. The contents of the booklets can
be briefly categorised as being of an anti-Government and anti-
communistic nature. The principal articles are:-

(1) Editorial advocating nation wide anti-Japanese resistance
with the subsequent overthrow of the dictator of the
Nanking Government.

(2) Article dealing with the dispute between Kwangsi and
Nanking in which it is stated that if Nanking continues to
suppress anti-Japanese forces, civil war will be inevitable

(3) Article dealing with the Chengtu Incident, criticising the
weak policy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

(4) Article denouncing political dictatorship, supporting

主题 来自天津的两箱反政府宣传品抵达，收件人为邓周渝（Teng Chou Yu）。

由 D.S. Pitts 制作。由 J. Boyne D.S.I. 转发。

关于附上的赛宗路108号成始中学（Cheng Shih Secondary School）校长陈春（Chen Chun）致法国警察信件的译文内容，我必须报告，作为陈春和邓周渝代表的李文炳（Li Vung Ping）于1936年12月3日上午10点40分左右拜访了托马斯·库克父子公司，并支付了16.38美元，这笔款项代表了上述两箱物品的运输和交付费用。

在李文炳的允许和陪同下，D.S. Pitts 和职员 Lung Loong Oen 于上午11点前往广东路的托马斯·库克父子公司仓库，检查了箱内物品。

发现了约2,500册附上的小册子，题为《三民主义月刊》。进一步检查显示，这些副本包括第8卷，第1期和第2期合刊，日期为1936年8月31日。其编辑为刘左瀛（Liu Tso Ying），他是胡汉民先生西南集团的重要成员。这些小册子的内容可简要归类为反政府和反共性质。主要文章包括：

(1) 社论，主张全国抗日，随后推翻南京政府的独裁者。

(2) 处理广西与南京之间纠纷的文章，其中指出如果南京继续镇压抗日力量，内战将不可避免

(3) 处理成都事件的文章，批评外交部的软弱政策。

(4) 谴责政治独裁，支持

from the Cheng Shih Secondary School, 108 Route Say Zoong,

Shanghai, November 28, 1936.

Political Section.

Gentlemen,

I have the honour to inform you that this morning we received
through the post a letter in English from Messrs. Thos. Cook & Sons
addressed to TENG CHOU YOU (鄭祖禹), c/o CHEN JEN HO (陳人鶴),
Cheng Shih Secondary School (正始中學), Route Say Zoong). According
to the contents of the letter, two parcels of books sent from Tientsin
on the s.s. Ho Seng (和生), have arrived and the addressee is
requested to come to the offices of Thos. Cooks' to take delivery
against a payment of $16.38 delivery and transportation fees.

Our school has no teachers or employees of the name of TENG CHOU
YU. I have a friend of this name, but under interrogation he states
that he has no relations in Tientsin and knows nothing of the above
report.

Fearing that the matter is one of reactionary elements using
borrowed names in order to communicate among themselves, and in view
of the fact that I have reported this matter to the Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters, I am writing you the present letter in
order that you may make such enquiries as you may deem fit.

Yours, etc.

Signed: CHEN CHUN (陳群) (CHEN JEN HO).
Principal of the Cheng Shih Sec-
ondary School.

一封来自赛仲路（Route Say Zoong）108 号正始中学、致政治部的中文信函的译文，日期为 1936 年 11 月 28 日。

上海，1936 年 11 月 28 日。

政治部。

诸位先生：

谨此奉告，今晨我校通过邮政收到一封英文信件，由通济隆旅行社（Messrs. Thos. Cook & Sons）寄给郑祖禹（TENG CHOU YOU），转交陈人鹤（CHEN JEN HO），地址为正始中学（Cheng Shih Secondary School），赛仲路（Route Say Zoong）。据信内内容称，从天津经由“和生”轮（s.s. Ho Seng）寄出的两包书籍已抵达，要求收件人前往通济隆旅行社办事处，在支付 16.38 元递送及运输费后提取货物。

本校并无名为郑祖禹的教员或职员。我有一位同名朋友，但经询问，他表示自己在天津并无亲属，且对上述情况一无所知。

鉴于担心此事系反动分子使用借名以便相互联络，且我已将此事报告上海警备司令部，特致函贵部，以便贵部进行认为适当的调查。

此致，

签名：陈群（CHEN CHUN）（陈人鹤）。
正始中学校长。
